title: The Incredulity of Father Brown
author: Chesterton, G. K. (Gilbert Keith), 1874-1936
firstPublished: 1926: London, Cassell and Company (June 1926); New York, Dodd, Mead and Company (June 1926). The stories first appeared in magazines from 1923 (Dodd, Mead copyright 1923, 1924, 1926).
printBasis: Standard Ebooks text (CC0 1.0 dedication for its contributions), based on the Faded Page transcription (Distributed Proofreaders Canada, 2012; Faded Page pid 20120749, from the 1947 Cassell omnibus The Father Brown Stories) and the Internet Archive scan of the 1926 Cassell printing. Corrected by Bibliotheca Catholica to the wording of both 1926 printings where they agree against it (see corrections).
rights: Public domain in the USA. First published in 1926, before 1931; US copyright in 1926 works expired on January 1, 2022. Standard Ebooks dedicates its own contributions to the public domain (CC0 1.0). Outside the U.S., check local copyright rules.
standardEbooksRights: The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication.
standardEbooksCredits: Produced for Standard Ebooks by Vince Rice (first release December 4, 2022), proofread by Alex Cabal; transcription by Barbara Watson, Mary Meehan, Mark Akrigg, and Distributed Proofreaders Canada for Faded Page.
whyNotGutenberg: Project Gutenberg (US) has no ebook of The Incredulity of Father Brown (catalog checked 2026-11-09). The Project Gutenberg Australia and Faded Page files are not used: Faded Page asks permission for changed or commercial copies, and its file is a 1947 printing; the Standard Ebooks text is CC0.

iaWitness.title: The Incredulity Of Father Brown
iaWitness.publisher: London: Cassell and Company, Ltd. (title page verso: "First published June 1926, Second Impression August 1926")
iaWitness.note: Print witness: the Cassell London text of 1926, the base of the Standard Ebooks edition. Digital Library of India scan.

secondWitness.title: The Incredulity of Father Brown
secondWitness.publisher: New York: Dodd, Mead and Company ("First printing, June, 1926; Second printing, August, 1926")
secondWitness.note: Freely readable Internet Archive scan (not a lending copy). Used to confirm each correction; where the London and New York printings differ, the London (Cassell) reading is kept.

collation: Word-level comparison (2026-11-09) of the hosted text with the OCR of both 1926 scans: 97.8 percent of words align with the Cassell OCR and 99.5 percent with the Dodd, Mead OCR before OCR noise; every remaining difference that is not OCR noise, running heads, or a Standard Ebooks spelling or hyphenation modernization was a place where both 1926 printings agree against the Standard Ebooks text, and each was corrected (corrections). No passage of the 1926 text is missing.

includes: I. The Resurrection of Father Brown
III. The Oracle of the Dog
IV. The Miracle of Moon Crescent
V. The Curse of the Golden Cross
VII. The Doom of the Darnaways
VIII. The Ghost of Gideon Wise
omits: Standard Ebooks title page, imprint, colophon, Uncopyright, and cover art
extraction.method: tools/import_standard_ebooks.py: downloads the source XHTML at the pinned commit, converts each paragraph to a plain-text block (verse lines kept, italic and abbreviation markup dropped, word joiners removed, scene breaks as * * *), heads the stories with their 1926 numbers (I to VIII), heads the note NOTE as in the 1926 printings, and applies the corrections.
